_about: Newspaper headline templates (RULES.md §17), 2–3 versions of each so they don't repeat. The paper picks the highest-priority type that happened this month. 'ours' is used when the news is good for the reader's side, 'theirs' when it's bad: your own paper spins it (victories GLORIOUS, defeats STRATEGIC READJUSTMENTS). Each template has a 'head' (the big headline) and a 'deck' (the line under it). Placeholders are listed in 'placeholders'. See docs/DATA.md.

placeholders.{lane}: the lane's name, e.g. the Somme
placeholders.{side}: the reader's side, e.g. the Allies / our armies
placeholders.{enemy}: the other side, e.g. the Hun / the enemy
